stem.text: An excess of chlorine gas, $\text{Cl}_2$, is passed through 60 $\text{cm}^3$ of cold aqueous 0.1 $\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium hydroxide. In a separate experiment an excess of chlorine gas is passed through 60 $\text{cm}^3$ of hot aqueous 0.1 $\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ sodium hydroxide until no further reaction takes place.
How much **more** sodium chloride will be produced by the reaction with hot NaOH than with cold NaOH?
